rule: the project cards are the navigation
title: Deal
description: A padded card table: five real projects dealt from the dealer's deck, drag and throw them, flip a card for its facts, or spread all 30 in a labelled fan.
signature: A hand-rolled Verlet table deals face-down cards at 60 ms intervals that spin, land with a felt puff and turn face up. Drags tilt with pointer speed, hand their release velocity to the spring and snap to a predicted landing; Spread cascades the whole deck into a suit-labelled fan.
holdback: The opened case is a conventional sheet under the table; typographic cards are less vivid than picture cards; extra cards vanish rather than fly home when the spread gathers.
